claims.text: Clinician note documents Glucophage 850 mg twice daily as continuing, with HbA1c described as improving.
A staff note records that the pharmacy list shows metformin 500 mg twice daily, a different dose and brand from the clinician's Glucophage 850 mg twice daily entry.

citations.quote: Pharmacy list shows metformin 500 mg twice daily.

open_questions: The record does not show when metformin was first prescribed or at what dose and frequency.
The record does not show when Glucophage was first recorded or how it relates to earlier metformin prescriptions.

The record does not show whether the discrepancy between Glucophage 850 mg twice daily and metformin 500 mg twice daily was ever reconciled; the reviewing clinician should resolve which regimen is current.
The record contains no earlier HbA1c values, so no HbA1c trend can be described beyond 'improving'.
The record does not show other diabetes medications started or stopped earlier.
No allergies or reactions are recorded in the available entries.
No follow-ups, referrals or tests are recorded in the available entries.

citation.quote: Pharmacy list shows metformin 500 mg twice daily.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Pharmacy list records metformin 500 mg twice daily while the clinician note documents Glucophage 850 mg twice daily, an unresolved dose and product discrepancy.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Confirm which regimen is current with the prescribing clinician and reconcile the pharmacy list.
